Definition: from the base of G5494 and G4482; a storm-runlet, i.e. winter-torrent:--brook.
BiblicalUsage: A winter torrent is a brook that runs full in the rainy season, and Jesus crosses the brook Cedron with His disciples on the way to the garden. The brook is named once, at the edge of the arrest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the brook Cedron is part of the road to the cross: Jesus crosses the winter water to the garden where He will be taken, and He crosses it willingly.
RelatedEvents: The Arrest of Jesus in Gethsemane
